tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3301-3349 list the available commands and show exit code 1.

tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3354-3362: returned 'No build output found under bin\x64\Debug'.

tool_limitations.limitation: Recursive copying under the project directory omitted csproj-linked App, MainPage, styles, and media stored in SharedContent outside that directory.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Resolve external Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content/Resource Include items and copy their Link destinations before namespace rewrite and TODO injection.

tool_limitations.limitation: It did not identify UWP suspension subscriptions, handlers, or deferrals.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Route suspension lifecycle constructs to the lifecycle migration pattern.

failed_apis.why_tried: The copied UWP scenario pages subscribed to App.Current.Suspending to persist image state.
failed_apis.root_cause: WinUI 3 desktop Application has no UWP suspension event or deferral contract.
failed_apis.fix: Remove the subscription and deferral, persist incrementally, and use Window.Closed or AppWindow.Closing for a final best-effort save.

failed_apis.why_tried: MainWindow navigated immediately to MainPage, whose OnNavigatedTo read App.MainWindow.Bounds.
failed_apis.root_cause: The right-hand side of App.MainWindow = new MainWindow() completes before the static property is assigned.
failed_apis.fix: Keep the constructor inert and navigate only after assigning and activating the window.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build instruction
doc_errors.wrong: Preferred and required winapp build even though the installed winapp CLI exposes run but not build.
doc_errors.correct: Use native dotnet build with an explicit Debug platform; reserve winapp for packaged launch.

doc_errors.wrong: Claimed the folder walk was a complete inventory although old UWP csproj files can link source outside the project directory.
doc_errors.correct: Resolve linked project items into the copied-file list and fail if a linked input cannot be resolved.

special_apis.special_handling: Initialize each picker with the owning window HWND before PickSingleFileAsync or PickSaveFileAsync.
Expand project properties and Link metadata so external shared source enters the normal namespace-rewrite, TODO, and mapping pipeline.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103 InitializeComponent and generated control fields missing; CS0117/CS1061 MainPage.Current and NotifyUser missing
errors_encountered.root_cause: Externally linked shared shell files were omitted by bootstrap, then manually copied with mismatched x:Class and CLR namespaces.
errors_encountered.fix: Bootstrap linked files using their Link paths before migration so XAML/code-behind pairs and namespaces are transformed together.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061 Application has no definition for Suspending
errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP suspension lifecycle does not carry to WinUI 3 desktop.
errors_encountered.fix: Replace suspension persistence rather than adding a never-raised compatibility event.

errors_encountered.error: CS0246 MainWindow; CS0103 App and ComWrappersSupport
errors_encountered.root_cause: Manual shell and custom entry-point edits split types across SDKTemplate and SimpleImaging namespaces and omitted the required WinRT import.
errors_encountered.fix: Keep scaffold entry-point generation and align XAML/code-behind namespaces; avoid a custom Main unless activation logic requires it.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The DataTemplate x:DataType prefix did not resolve the namespace containing Scenario after manual shell copying.
errors_encountered.fix: Point x:DataType at the actual Scenario CLR namespace; do not treat the cascading WMC9999 as an unrelated code failure.

errors_encountered.root_cause: MainWindow navigated to MainPage in its constructor; MainPage.OnNavigatedTo dereferenced App.MainWindow before OnLaunched assigned it.
errors_encountered.fix: Assign and activate MainWindow before initial navigation.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent manually located SharedContent, copied shell files, and iterated through multiple namespace/XAML build failures.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: About 19 turns and four build attempts.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap omitted csproj-linked external source and therefore did not map, rewrite, or annotate it.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually aligned x:Class, namespaces, DataTemplate types, and shell references until the build succeeded.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Resolve external linked project items in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: winapp build failed, then Test-AppLaunch reported no build output.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill guidance assumed a nonexistent winapp build command, Test-AppLaunch did not support bin\Debug, and build/launch were started in parallel.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent switched to dotnet build and later dotnet run with Platform=x64.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Use native dotnet build guidance and support both platform-qualified and default Debug layouts.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The app built but crashed at startup; the agent gathered only native event 1000 and stopped without fixing it.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Constructor-time navigation reached MainPage before App.MainWindow assignment.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Follow the existing MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Initialization order - keep MainWindow's constructor inert' section.

missing_tooling.need: Linked MSBuild item discovery in bootstrap
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The manual SharedContent search/copy and the namespace/XAML error cascade.
The compile-only fake Suspending event that silently discarded persistence behavior.

env_issues.issue: Installed winapp CLI did not provide a build command.
env_issues.workaround: Use dotnet build; use winapp only through packaged run/launch tooling.
